summary: Bail granted by High Court solely on alleged belated compliance with NDPS Act s.52A; misinterpretation of sampling procedure; mandatory s.37 bail conditions ignored; strict interpretation of NDPS Act required for societal impact; preponderance standard for evidentiary gaps; bail reversed due to failure to record s.37 findings; illicit drug trafficking prevention prioritized over liberal bail approach.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court bail order set aside; respondent remanded to custody.
